theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+2.07%) and Industrials (+0.81%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.55%) and Communication Svcs (-1.44%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.31%, defensives -0.62%, and value/cyclicals +0.33% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.19%, Dow +0.04%, Nasdaq +0.04% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.35%. The VIX rose 0.43% to 16.39, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.13% to $4,199.90, crude oil was little changed at $92.97, and bitcoin gained 0.33% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
